name: Asobi
source:
You're a private taxi driver.
You receive reservations.
Reach the pick-up point.
Then drive your clients toward their destination.

Tonight, you have to take a girl to a hotel.
But who is she?
Why is she going there?

[From [url=https://team-soletude.itch.io/asobi]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一名私人出租车司机。
接到预约，
前往接客地点，
再将乘客送到目的地。

今晚，你要送一个女孩去酒店。
但她是谁？
又为什么要去那里？

[摘自[url=https://team-soletude.itch.io/asobi]itch.io[/url]]
